correctness.rationale: For fixed driver-sign path, independent Bernoulli rows yield independent bounded zeta_n with conditional mean product over odd binomial coefficients. Lucas parity gives 2^popcount(S_n) factors and |mean|<=q^(2^popcount). The geometric holding times are O(log N) maximally almost surely by Borel-Cantelli; visits with <=2 log2 log N binary ones number N^o(1), and all remaining conditional means are exp(-c (log N)^2). Hence drift is N^o(1), variance N-o(N), and Kolmogorov independent bounded-array LIL applies with +/-1. Fubini transposes joint almost-sure to quenched for Q-a.e. environment. Bounded martingale jumps and off-diagonal bracket o(N) give the quenched functional CLT. Lucas checked independently for S<=256.
